faqSchema.source:
Every person and every procedure is different, so no dentist can promise treatment will be completely pain-free. Dr Meg uses gentle techniques, explains each step before it happens, and would much rather you spoke up than sat through something uncomfortable.

Not at all — it is more common than most people think. Dr Meg has spent years looking after nervous patients and takes an unhurried approach: we listen first, explain what to expect, and move at a pace that feels manageable to you.

General and preventive care, fillings, crowns and bridges, children’s dentistry, selected extractions, partial dentures, mouthguards, night guards, dental implants, root canal treatment and selected diode laser procedures. Your dentist will assess whether a particular treatment is appropriate for you.

Yes — assessment, placement and restoration for suitable single and multiple implant cases. All-on-4 treatment is not currently on the list. Whether implants are right for you can only be confirmed after a clinical assessment.

That is the whole idea. Continuity sits at the centre of how Lava Street Dental is being set up: Dr Meg wants to be the dentist you know, who remembers your history and your family.

A Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry at the University of Victoria in Canada, a PhD in Medical Oncology at the University of Oxford, and her Doctor of Dental Medicine at the University of Western Australia.

Lava Street Dental accepts all private health funds and is not restricted to a preferred-provider network. Eligible patients can also access treatment through CDBS and DVA arrangements. Afterpay and humm payment plans are available to eligible patients. Health fund claims can be made on the spot with our Tyro terminal, and we accept card payments. Provider terms, eligibility requirements and conditions apply. We will explain what is involved and what it costs before treatment goes ahead.

fields.label: Photo description
fields.value: Dr Meg Takiguchi, principal dentist at Lava Street Dental.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: A country dentist, with a modern twist.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Lava Street Dental brings the warmth and familiarity of regional dental care together with modern clinical technology. The approach is personal and considered, and it is built around knowing the people we look after.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Whether you are in for a routine check-up or something more involved, Dr Meg takes the time to understand what is worrying you, talks through your options in plain language, and helps you feel comfortable at every stage.

fields.label: Photo description
fields.value: Treatment room with dental chair and sage cabinetry at Lava Street Dental, Warrnambool

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Dr Meg Takiguchi grew up on the outskirts of Tokyo and has spent the last ten years in dentistry, most of it in regional Western Australia. She graduated with a Doctor of Dental Medicine from the University of Western Australia in 2016, after a Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry in Canada and a PhD in Medical Oncology at the University of Oxford.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Working in towns with limited access to specialists shaped how she practises. She is comfortable across a broad range of dentistry — implants, root canal treatment, difficult extractions, crowns, bridges and dentures — and she is known for a gentle hand and a very light touch with injections.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Her hope for Lava Street Dental is simple: to become the dentist you keep coming back to, year after year.

fields.label: Fine print
fields.value: Dr Meg is a general dentist. Her PhD in Medical Oncology is a research qualification and is not a dental specialist registration.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: From routine visits to more involved treatment, for families across Warrnambool, Port Fairy and the districts in between.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A proper look at how things are tracking, then a clean using warm water, air and a fine powder — far kinder than the old scrape.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Careful restorative work, with laboratory-made crowns and bridges planned to bring back comfort, function and the look of your smile.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Assessment, placement and restoration of single or multiple implants, using implant systems chosen for the long haul.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Treatment aimed at keeping a tooth you would rather not lose, with referral to an endodontist when a case calls for specialist care.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Calm, age-appropriate visits that help children build good habits early and feel at home in the chair.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Planned extractions, including more involved surgical cases, where that is the right call clinically.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Also available: diode laser treatment for selected gum procedures, plus custom mouthguards and night guards. Suitability for implants, root canal treatment, laser procedures and extractions can only be confirmed after a clinical assessment with your dentist.

<script src="assets/js/site.js" defer></script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var body = document.body;
  var still = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ---------- Hero capture form ----------
       Inline validation, then a POST to /api/waitlist/ (Vercel function, emails
       via SMTP2GO). On success the card swaps to a confirmation. */
  var heroForm = document.getElementById('heroForm');
  var captureInner = document.getElementById('captureInner');
  var heroStatus = document.getElementById('heroStatus');
  var started = document.getElementById('hStartedAt');
  if (started) { started.value = String(Date.now()); }

  function auPhone(v) {
    var d = v.replace(/[\s().-]/g, '');
    if (d.indexOf('+61') === 0) { d = '0' + d.slice(3); }
    return /^0[2-478]\d{8}$/.test(d);
  }
  var RULES = [
    { id: 'hFirst', key: 'firstName', msg: 'We just need a first name.', test: function (v) { return v.length > 0; } },
    { id: 'hLast', key: 'lastName', msg: 'And a last name.', test: function (v) { return v.length > 0; } },
    { id: 'hEmail', key: 'email', msg: 'Could you check that email address?', test: function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(v); } },
    { id: 'hPhone', key: 'phone', msg: 'Please enter an Australian number, for example 0412 345 678.', test: function (v) { return v === '' || auPhone(v); } },
    { id: 'hConsent', key: 'consent', msg: 'Please tick the box so we can contact you.', check: true, test: function () { return document.getElementById('hConsent').checked; } }
  ];
  function valueOf(rule) { var el = document.getElementById(rule.id); return rule.check ? '' : el.value.trim(); }
  function mark(rule, ok, text) {
    var input = document.getElementById(rule.id);
    var msg = document.getElementById(rule.id + 'Msg');
    input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', ok ? 'false' : 'true');
    msg.textContent = ok ? '' : (text || rule.msg);
    return ok;
  }
  RULES.forEach(function (rule) {
    var input = document.getElementById(rule.id);
    input.addEventListener(rule.check ? 'change' : 'blur', function () {
      if (rule.check || input.value.trim() !== '' || input.getAttribute('aria-invalid') === 'true') {
        mark(rule, rule.test(valueOf(rule)));
      }
    });
    if (!rule.check) {
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        if (input.getAttribute('aria-invalid') === 'true' && rule.test(valueOf(rule))) { mark(rule, true); }
      });
    }
  });

  function showDone(name) {
    captureInner.innerHTML = '';
    var done = document.createElement('div');
    done.className = 'capture-done';
    var h = document.createElement('h2');
    h.className = 'capture-h';
    h.textContent = 'You\u2019re on the list, ' + name + '.';
    var p1 = document.createElement('p');
    p1.className = 'small';
    p1.textContent = 'Thank you. We have sent a confirmation to your email, and you will hear from us before the books open publicly.';
    done.appendChild(h);
    done.appendChild(p1);
    captureInner.appendChild(done);
    captureInner.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    h.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    h.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  var sending = false;
  heroForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (sending) { return; }
    heroStatus.textContent = '';
    var firstBad = null;
    RULES.forEach(function (rule) {
      var ok = mark(rule, rule.test(valueOf(rule)));
      if (!ok && !firstBad) { firstBad = document.getElementById(rule.id); }
    });
    if (firstBad) { firstBad.focus(); return; }

    var button = heroForm.querySelector('.btn-submit');
    var label = button.textContent;
    sending = true;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    button.textContent = 'Sending\u2026';
    var payload = {
      firstName: document.getElementById('hFirst').value.trim(),
      lastName: document.getElementById('hLast').value.trim(),
      email: document.getElementById('hEmail').value.trim(),
      phone: document.getElementById('hPhone').value.trim(),
      consent: document.getElementById('hConsent').checked,
      company: document.getElementById('hCompany').value,
      startedAt: started ? started.value : ''
    };
    fetch('/api/waitlist/', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }).then(function (data) { data.status = r.status; return data; }); })
      .then(function (data) {
        if (data.ok) { showDone(payload.firstName); return; }
        if (data.fields) {
          var first = null;
          RULES.forEach(function (rule) {
            if (data.fields[rule.key]) { mark(rule, false, data.fields[rule.key]); if (!first) { first = document.getElementById(rule.id); } }
          });
          if (first) { first.focus(); }
        }
        heroStatus.textContent = (data.error || 'Sorry, something went wrong.') + FALLBACK;
      })
      .catch(function () {
        heroStatus.textContent = 'We could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.' + FALLBACK;
      })
      .then(function () {
        sending = false;
        if (document.body.contains(button)) {
          button.disabled = false;
          button.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
          button.textContent = label;
        }
      });
  });
  var FALLBACK = heroForm.getAttribute('data-fallback') || '';

  /* ---------- Smooth anchors, offset for the sticky masthead ---------- */
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var link = e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');
    if (!link) { return; }
    var id = link.getAttribute('href');
    if (id === '#') { e.preventDefault(); return; }
    var target = document.querySelector(id);
    if (!target) { return; }
    e.preventDefault();
    var y = target === body ? 0 : target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 84;
    window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(y, 0), behavior: still ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
    if (id !== '#top') { history.replaceState(null, '', id); }
    if (target !== body) {
      if (!target.hasAttribute('tabindex')) { target.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); }
      target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  });

  /* ---------- Image slots: hide a missing file so the warm placeholder behind it
       reads cleanly. Delete once assets/images/ is populated. ---------- */
  function hideIfBroken(img) {
    if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth === 0) { img.style.visibility = 'hidden'; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('error', function (e) {
    if (e.target.tagName === 'IMG') { e.target.style.visibility = 'hidden'; }
  }, true);
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.images, hideIfBroken);
}());
</script>
</body>
</html>
